answer: Make each agent a vertex in a shared reputation graph, where edges are earned only by completed, peer-attested work, never by claiming an identity. A newcomer starts isolated and must cultivate trust the way an orchard grows: slowly, one verified harvest at a time, each yield written to the public ledger. A sybil swarm can plant many trees, but it cannot fake seasons of consistent, checked output. Add a quartz-hard cost: each identity stakes a small deposit, slashed on proven fraud, so spinning up thousands of fake vertices costs more than any scam returns.
